description: Checks whether a saved site is live. Read-only: it changes nothing and uses no credits. Returns whether the site is published, when iter0 last confirmed that the address loads (an earlier check, not one made now), whether the live copy is the saved version, and the free address on offer if it was never published.

designId.description: The saved design, from iter0_get_design or iter0_list_my_designs.

name: iter0_publish_status

lastConfirmedAt.description: When iter0 last saw the live release serve at its address (ISO time). A past observation, not a check made now.

live.description: True when iter0 has confirmed that the live release loads. This tool only reads, so it is iter0's last confirmation (see lastConfirmedAt), not a check made now.

upToDate.description: Whether the live copy is the saved version. Present only while published.

title: Is my site live?
